identity.role: Canonical brand, commerce, Studio OS and product platform repository

architecture.style: Local-first static applications with isolated dependency-light modules and contract-driven governance

boundaries.name: static-storefront
boundaries.rule: Dependency-free static storefront and product previews; shared page, style and data changes are coupled and must be verified together.

boundaries.name: execution-governance
boundaries.rule: Models approval, risk, rollback, idempotency and policy; never dispatches execution.

boundaries.name: execution-readiness
boundaries.rule: Evaluates readiness only; a readiness decision never grants execution permission.

boundaries.name: ai-workforce-control-center
boundaries.rule: Local cockpit and projection layer; browser roles are not an authorization boundary and runtime mutations remain blocked.

boundaries.name: etsy-intelligence-engine
boundaries.rule: Local-first CSV intelligence; imported data stays in-browser and external adapters must remain isolated.

boundaries.name: listing-intelligence-engine
boundaries.rule: Consumes validated product and market evidence to produce deterministic listing packages; no product creation, marketplace publishing or undocumented API use.

entrypoints.runtime: modern browser via local file or static host
modern browser via local file or static host
modern browser via local file or static HTTP server

dependencies.repository: No repository-wide build tool or external runtime dependency is documented.
dependencies.aiWorkforceControlCenter: Standalone browser module; no external dependencies.
dependencies.etsyIntelligenceEngine: Standalone browser module; no installation or API key required.

listingIntelligenceEngine.runtime: Node.js >=22 for CLI and tests; browser for dashboard

gates: Respect allowed read/write paths and preserve the dirty worktree.
Reject secret access, provider calls, deployments and runtime execution while disabled in config/studio.config.json.
Do not edit protected or excluded outputs unless the task explicitly names and authorizes an exact path.
Run task-scoped checks before broader validation; report every skipped or failed check.
Require human review for marketplace publishing, trademarks, legal or policy claims and image-to-copy consistency.
Keep dashboard code read-only with respect to runtime and governance decisions.

fileContextBaseline.limitations: Counts are a supplied point-in-time baseline, not live telemetry; generated, cached, secret and runtime output paths may be excluded by different tools.
